title: Security Misconfiguration
description: Security misconfiguration is an insecure setting or missing hardening in an application, framework, server, cloud service, or deployment environment.
indicators: default accounts or passwords remain active
overly permissive cross-origin or resource policies
detailed errors or missing security directives
prevention: Establish and repeatedly verify a minimal hardened configuration for every environment.
Disable unused features and replace defaults with secure settings.
Automate configuration checks and avoid exposing internal errors or unnecessary services.
source: OWASP Top 10:2025 A02 Security Misconfiguration (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A02_2025-Security_Misconfiguration/); MITRE CWE-16 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/16.html)
